mechanism: Discrete Hartley transform maps N real Open prices to real harmonics H[0]…H[N−1] (cas=cos+sin). Sensors: (1) zero high-index harmonics (CutOff) then inverse DHT → smoothed series; (2) divide all harmonics by a constant; (3) hyperbolic attenuation by frequency; (4) keep only |H[k]| above mean absolute harmonic; (5) flip harmonic signs for opposite-phase / S-R construction. Can also multiply signal spectrum by an indicator spectrum (e.g. LWMA) for frequency-domain filtering.
data_needed: N Open (or price) samples; precomputed cas table size (N−1)^2+1; CutOff/Constant/Hyperbolic/Strong/Inverse flags
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic price series; example N=15 Open; attached DHT.mq5 / DHT_LWMA.mq5 / Spectrum.mq5

quote: DHT uses only real numbers, which makes it more convenient for implementation in practice, and the results of its application are more visual.

mechanism: From DHT energy E[k]=H[k]^2 build colored-noise spectra EN[k]∝f^p with p∈{−2 red, −1 pink, 0 white, +1 blue, +2 violet}, scale so total energy matches the signal, take sqrt for HN, copy signal harmonic signs (or invert/force ±). Author maps: red ≈ long-term trends/cycles; white ≈ flat; violet ≈ random/unpredictable. Noise Levels / Noise Indicator attach these as chart overlays or coefficient sets.
data_needed: Signal DHT spectrum; frequency index k; noise color p; optional sign mode; indicator power E>0 for coefficient design

mechanism: Estimate continuous noise exponent p from the energy spectrum via four sums over k=1…N−1 involving log-frequency and log-energy, then p from the closed-form ratio of those coefficients. mechanism: Rolling Pearson r (optional Olkin–Pratt bias fix) and Spearman rank ρ between two symbols. Collect historical sample correlations; trigger when current r/ρ reaches an explicit level (e.g. −0.95/−0.9) or the bottom 10% of the historical distribution. Prefer historically negative mean correlation. Position sides gated by each symbol vs its MA; volumes inverse to PointValue so equal point moves ≈ equal P&L. Breakeven at 33% path back; close at 67% (capped at 0).
data_needed: Paired price windows length iPeriod; Pearson/Spearman; historical correlation sample; MA for side; PointValue for sizing

mechanism: For two integrated series estimate d[i]=y[i]−k·x[i]−m by least squares so d stays near zero. Prefer pairs whose residual frequently changes sign historically. Open opposite legs when |d| hits an extreme; close when d returns to zero. Illustrative integrated paths use uniform/normal/Cauchy increments to motivate cointegration.
data_needed: Two symbol price series; OLS k,m; residual d history and sign-change count; extreme/zero thresholds
